component.name: Cosmic
component.summary: A customizable desktop web browser focused on privacy

description.p: Cosmic is a Chromium-based desktop browser built with Qt. It gives you control over how you browse and organize the web.

ul.li: Organize browsing with tabs, tab groups, profiles, and restorable sessions.
Customize the toolbar, appearance, search engines, and new-tab page.
Manage site permissions, cookies, HTTPS-only mode, and request blocking.
Store credentials in an encrypted vault on your device.
